assessment.invariant: Each file keeps its seeded storage and scenarios.

findings.summary: Stale test titles, mocks, comments and unrestored globals mislead readers

assessment.reason: Readers look for behaviour that no longer exists and global mutations depend on per-file isolation.
evidence: signals.test.ts still stubs CSS.escape that no source uses; ai.test.ts mocks findBestMatch for a function that does not exist; filler.test.ts titles 'focuses the element' assert blur.
SettingsSection.test.tsx assigns URL.createObjectURL and prototypes without restore; parser.test.ts workAuthorization cases use statuses outside WorkAuthorizationStatus.
assessment.invariant: Test intent and assertions stay unchanged; only names, comments and cleanup change.

findings.summary: Some tests are vacuous, tautological or hide nondeterminism

assessment.reason: They cannot fail on the regression they name or absorb a real ordering bug with retries.
evidence: ImportReviewScreen.test.tsx:148-155 clicks a disabled button, so the body-click propagation is never exercised.
workAuthorization.test.ts:23-35 assert values derived from the same map; ResumeImportSection.test.tsx:218-246 uses retry: 2 with a comment blaming queue ordering.
assessment.invariant: Each test's intended guarantee is kept and made able to fail.

findings.summary: Playwright specs repeat popup and options opening, layout probes and theme toggling

assessment.reason: A change to how the popup is pinned to the source tab or to layout bounds needs about 40 edits.
evidence: The popup init-script plus goto is written seven times in fill-log.pw.ts and responsive.pw.ts and as two diverging popupFor helpers; options.html URL building appears about 33 times.
The no-horizontal-scroll check appears about nine times and the 64 px sidebar check four times; learned-mappings.pw.ts settle() is a fixed 200 ms sleep before positive assertions.
assessment.invariant: Popups stay pinned to the source tab at 380x600 where bounds are asserted and the same tolerances apply.

findings.summary: pdf.js worker setup is duplicated and extractLinks never destroys its document

assessment.reason: There are two ways to load pdf.js with two copies of the worker URL, and only one path cleans up.
evidence: extractLinks.ts:1-8 configures GlobalWorkerOptions at module load; validateResumeFile.ts:105-130 repeats it after a dynamic import and destroys its loading task.
assessment.invariant: Bundling behaviour and the pdfjs-dist mock order in extractLinks.test.ts stay valid.
